name: ghoul
description: This manifest is used when building Ghoul standalone from this checkout. The port under support/vcpkg/ports/ghoul declares the same runtime dependencies for consumers; support/vcpkg/check-manifest-sync.cmake verifies that the two lists stay in sync.
Ghoul's overrides (lua 5.4.7) cannot be expressed by a port, so a superproject that consumes the port has to repeat them in its own manifest.
